comment: Ground truth for the lab fixtures. Names are normalised to lowercase letters and digits, so innerHTML, .innerHTML = and innerHTML( all match innerhtml.

labs.notes: location.hash flows into innerHTML
location.search flows into innerHTML through URLSearchParams
location.hash flows into document.write
location.hash runs through eval
location.hash is passed to setTimeout as a string
window.name flows into insertAdjacentHTML
the sink lives in the external app.js
inline onerror carries an innerHTML sink fed by location.hash
srcdoc is a DOM XSS sink and must be reported
the Function constructor compiles location.hash
mixed case sinks; every pattern is case insensitive
no script, no source, no sink
textContent never parses markup
the sink is reachable but the sanitizer escapes the input, so it must not be exploited
every dangerous pattern is inside a comment or a string literal
template content is inert and scripting is enabled, so noscript never renders
the dangerous looking text is data in an application/json block
handler syntax appears only inside literal attribute values and text
105 inline handlers, past the warning threshold
entry page links to page2, page3 and a missing page
the server answers after five seconds while the timeout is one second
